origin: Original practice stimulus; reviewed axis/unit derivation

data.unit_rule: Vertical-axis unit divided by horizontal-axis unit; angle/count ratios may be dimensionless.
data.model_limit: Idealised practice data only. Do not infer that every real dataset is exact, that every line passes through the origin, or that the gradient is automatically a familiar constant.

gradient_meaning: The slope is secondary voltage per turn, 0.05 V per turn, equal to Vp/Np in the ideal model. These open-circuit readings do not measure efficiency.
aim: test secondary voltage against turn count with fixed primary conditions
arrangement: A purpose-built low-voltage AC transformer kit, fixed primary winding and core, selectable secondary turns and AC voltmeters
